title: XMH: Explainable Metaheuristics via Exact-Coalition Operator-Level Shapley Value Attribution
description: Python framework for exact Shapley value attribution at the operator level in metaheuristic algorithms. Includes instrumented implementations of DE, GA, PSO, CMA-ES, SHADE and JADE, four attribution methods, and the raw per-run coalition values behind every quantitative claim of the manuscript. Version 1.5.0 adds validate_instrumentation(), the check for the framework's silent failure mode: an operator that is registered but never applied through its registered handle receives a Shapley value of exactly zero, indistinguishable from a legitimate null player. The empty-coalition check the method already performs is necessary but not sufficient for this, as the release notes show by injecting the defect. Earlier versions remain included.
